title: UK Skilled Worker Visa Salary 2026: Singapore Guide
metaDescription: UK Skilled Worker visa salary rules 2026 for Singapore applicants: salary thresholds, going rates, eligible jobs, sponsorship and how your pay is assessed.
headline: UK Skilled Worker Visa Salary 2026: A Guide for Applicants in Singapore

sections.title: How the Skilled Worker salary test works
sections.content:
The UK Skilled Worker visa requires a job offer from a licensed sponsor in an eligible occupation. Your salary must meet both the general salary threshold and the going rate for your occupation, and the higher of the two normally applies. This dual test stops employers from using sponsorship to undercut local pay.

Thresholds and going rates are updated periodically, so a figure quoted in an old guide may no longer be correct. Before accepting an offer, check the current rules on GOV.UK and confirm the occupation code, contracted hours and salary stated in your certificate of sponsorship.

sections.title: What counts towards your salary
sections.content:
Only certain payments count towards the salary threshold. Basic gross pay for your contracted hours is the core figure, while some allowances may count if they are guaranteed. Overtime, bonuses that are not guaranteed and deductions for items such as accommodation can be treated differently, so the headline salary in a job advert is not always the assessed figure.

Part-time roles need careful checking, because the salary is normally assessed against the full-time going rate on a pro-rata basis. If your contracted hours are lower, your pay must still meet the pro-rated threshold. Ask your sponsor to confirm the exact assessed salary before you pay the visa fee.

sections.title: Jobs, sponsorship and dependants
sections.content:
Not every job can be sponsored. Your role must appear on the eligible occupations list, and your sponsor must hold a valid sponsor licence for that route. Health and care roles have their own salary arrangements, and some shortage roles have historically had lower going rates, although shortage rules have changed over time.

Skilled Worker visa holders can usually bring a partner and dependent children, subject to financial and relationship requirements. Dependants can generally work in the UK, with limited restrictions. Settlement after five years depends on meeting the salary and continuous residence rules in force at that time.

sections.title: Applying from Singapore
sections.content:
Applicants in Singapore apply online, provide biometrics and submit documents including a valid passport, certificate of sponsorship and evidence of English language ability and funds if required. Processing times vary with demand, so apply well before your planned start date and avoid booking non-refundable travel early.

Keep copies of your employment contract, payslips if you are already employed by the sponsor, and any qualification certificates. If your salary or hours change after your visa is granted, tell your sponsor promptly, since a significant change may require a new application or updated sponsorship.

faqs.q: What salary do I need for a UK Skilled Worker visa?
faqs.a: Your salary must meet both the general threshold and the going rate for your occupation, with the higher figure normally applying. Thresholds change periodically, so check the current GOV.UK rules and your certificate of sponsorship before applying. A job offer below either figure will not qualify.

faqs.q: Does overtime count towards the salary threshold?
faqs.a: Guaranteed basic pay for contracted hours is the main figure that counts. Non-guaranteed overtime and some bonuses may not count, and deductions can reduce the assessed salary. Ask your sponsor to confirm the exact salary figure that will appear on your certificate of sponsorship.

faqs.q: Can I bring my family on a Skilled Worker visa?
faqs.a: Yes, you can usually bring a partner and dependent children if you meet the relationship and financial requirements. Dependants can generally work in the UK, with limited restrictions. Check the current dependant rules on GOV.UK, since financial requirements and restrictions can change.

faqs.q: How long does a Skilled Worker visa last?
faqs.a: The visa is normally granted for up to five years, depending on your certificate of sponsorship. After five years of continuous residence you may qualify for settlement if you meet the salary and other rules in force at that time. Always confirm current settlement requirements before planning around them.
